Subject: Staged cutover & adoption plan — Onyx Health MAP and timeline

Hi Sara —

Great to meet last week. Per our conversation I put together a lightweight staged cutover and adoption plan that ties milestones to owners and proposed dates. The goal is to minimize risk by splitting the rollout into three phases (Pilot, Broad Rollout, Adoption & Training) and to align procurement, security sign-off, and technical prep.

Attached: ONYX_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan) and Cutover_Checklist_v2.pdf (technical cutover checklist). Highlights below:

- Phase 0 (Procurement & Contracting): PO & contract countersigned — target by 2026-06-18 (Onyx procurement)
- Phase 1 (Pilot): 2-week pilot with a representative internal team — target start 2026-07-01; Redwood to supply dedicated staging capacity and run acceptance tests
- Phase 2 (Broad Rollout): staggered accounts over 3 weeks — target 2026-07-15 to 2026-08-05
- Phase 3 (Adoption & Training): training sessions + playbook hand-off — target complete by 2026-08-20

Action items for this thread:
1) Sara: confirm pilot cohort and pilot success criteria (UAT pass rate, latency SLOs, sample prompts)
2) Onyx procurement: confirm PO timeline and any paperwork required (cc'd procurement address)
3) Marcus: validate network & firewall requirements for staging (attached Network_Requirements.docx)
4) Monica: schedule enablement sessions and prepare the adoption playbook

If that timeline looks feasible I can lock in the staging cluster and send a brief runbook for pilot-day ops.

Thanks —

Stephanie Nguyen

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. This looks sensible. A few clarifying notes from our side:

- Pilot cohort: we'll use the Clinical Insights team (~8 users) and include 5 sample prompts for evaluation. I will confirm success criteria by EOD Thursday 2026-06-03.
- Procurement: I've looped in procurement (see cc). We typically need net-30 + an internal security attestation. Procurement will flag if they need a formal SOW.
- Security: we require an in-scope SOC 2 snapshot and a simple data flow diagram for the pilot (we can accept a table).

Request: can Marcus confirm whether staging can be isolated within our VPC and whether the KV cache will be cleared between pilot runs? Also, please share the pilot runbook for Day 0 ops.

I'll also introduce Tom Rooker (platform ops) in a follow-up to coordinate firewall openings.

Best,

Sara / Stephanie —

Short answers to Sara's questions:

- VPC isolation: yes, we can run the pilot in a customer-dedicated VPC peering arrangement. For the staging cluster we'll provision a dedicated subnet and RBAC so only the pilot cohort has access.
- KV cache: by default we snapshot the KV cache between pilot runs; we can schedule a cache clear after each day's run. That's in the Cutover_Checklist_v2 under 'cache management'.
- Network requirements: Tom / Onyx ops will need TCP 443 outbound to our staging endpoints and an SSH jump host is optional. Full port list in Network_Requirements.docx.

I will prepare a short Day 0 runbook and post it to the Drive link (see thread metadata). Expect it by 2026-06-05.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
